summary: AstraZeneca furnished its Q3 and 9M 2026 results via Form 6-K, equivalent to a US domestic quarterly earnings release. Total revenue rose 7% at CER to $46.9bn for 9M and 7% to $16.2bn for Q3; Core EPS grew 14% to $8.00 for 9M and 19% to $2.79 for Q3. Management reconfirmed FY2026 guidance of mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth and low-double-digit Core EPS growth, citing 12 positive Phase III readouts. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisors are stated. Watch pipeline readouts rather than deal arbitrage.
